purpose.summary: This is a patient inquiry/search screen component (Q01 – basic patient information, P01) of the ORCA JMA Standard Receipt Software, a Japanese medical billing system. It handles patient master lookup, display, and related data (insurance numbers, diagnoses, addresses, etc.) for a clinic/hospital front-end.

verdict.notes: The file is part of the open-source ORCA (JMA Standard Receipt Software) project, a well-known Japanese medical billing system. Comments are in Japanese EUC encoding but were decoded as latin-1, producing garbled characters. The program is a screen handler (not CICS) using the ORCA MCP framework. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of ~290KB; the full file is 7536 lines.
